title: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning for Atari (SimPLe)

methods.one_paragraph_description: Simulated Policy Learning: iteratively (15 loops) collects 6400 real interactions with the current policy, trains a video-prediction world model (best: stochastic discrete latent model), then trains a PPO policy inside the learned model using short rollouts (N=50) restarted from random real states; 102,400 real interactions total.
methods.conventional_lineage_hint: model-based deep RL ('a complete model-based deep RL algorithm based on video prediction models', abstract)
